reviews.text: After receiving many ridiculously high quotes,  I contacted Pacific Handyman Service & Remodeling. They were quick to respond. They were much lower than other quotes and were able to book us in a few days.  There work was fabulous. I will call them anytime I need work done in the future!

Pacific Handyman Service & Remodeling was hired by my landlord to fix my bathroom faucets I can't believe how quickly they responded and completed the project. My landlord was more than pleased with his quality of work and his fair price. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone in need.

We needed our front walkway repaired. The walk had been lifted by a tree root. I called several vendors. In the main response was terrible. Only Pacific Handyman Service & Remodeling were responsive. The team were timely and the work excellent. I really appreciated that they tackled a relatively small but difficult job. I highly Pacific Handyman Service & Remodeling

Mathew returned my call promptly, arranged an appt to come see what work had to be done, took notes and measurements and emailed me an estimate the next day! He had approx 30 paintings, photos and mirrors to hang in my home and he did everything very professionally, taking the time to map things out before hammer, nails and drill. Worked diligently and efficiently and were very pleasant. The finished work was perfect and they even vacuumed up afterwards.

Mike was exactly on time, which was impressive since the job was somewhat urgent in my opinion, and other places would have probably marked it as not very important. He got here, got the job done in a timely matter, and I felt very comfortable leaving him to do his job while I stepped away to not bother him. He left everything clean when he left as well. Service was great and efficient, and I was very happy with the job that was done.
